## Summary
Resolves [LNDENG-5610](https://warthogs.atlassian.net/browse/LNDENG-5610)
Login rejected valid email addresses such as `user+tag@example.com`. The LoginForm regex only allowed `[a-zA-Z0-9-_.]` before the `@`, so plus addressing and the other characters RFC 5322 allows were blocked. The other email fields use Yup's `.email()`, which follows different rules from the server.

This PR adds `src/utils/validation/email.ts` with one schema per server validator, so each form accepts and rejects the same addresses as the endpoint it submits to:

- `emailSchema()` mirrors pydantic `EmailStr` (pydantic 2.4.2 → email-validator 2.2.0, syntax checks only, default options), used by self-hosted account creation.
- `legacyEmailSchema()` mirrors `canonical.lib.mail.is_email_address`, used by the person (profile) and invitation endpoints: ASCII-only local part, special-use domains such as `corp.local` allowed, no dot required in the domain, IPv4 literals rejected.
- Login keeps a basic `local@domain` check so existing users whose stored address predates either rule can still sign in.

`normalizeEmail()` is applied before submit (whitespace stripped, NFC, domain mapped per UTS 46 including the Unicode dots), so an address saved verbatim by a legacy endpoint matches the one login derives from the same input.

**Forms:**

| Form | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| `LoginForm` (when `isIdentityAvailable` is false) | custom regex + `.test()` | `basicEmailSchema()` + `normalizeEmail()` |
| `InviteAdministratorForm` | Yup `.email()` | `legacyEmailSchema()` + `normalizeEmail()` |
| `EditUserForm` (general settings) | Yup `.email()` | `legacyEmailSchema()` + `normalizeEmail()`; unchanged or server-supplied emails are not re-validated |
| `AccountCreationSelfHostedForm` | Yup `.email()`, message "Invalid email address" | `emailSchema()`, message unified to "Please provide a valid email address" |

**What `emailSchema()` checks** (a hand port of email-validator's `syntax.py` and `validate_email.py`, no new dependencies, about 3 KB gzipped):
- **Local part:** RFC 5322 atext (including `+ ! # $ % & ' * / = ? ^ _ \` { | } ~`); no leading, trailing or consecutive dots; at most 64 characters. Unicode is allowed, except control, format, separator and private-use characters, and a combining mark in first position. The NFC form must also be valid.
- **Domain:** at least one dot, letters/digits/hyphens per label (no leading or trailing hyphen), labels at most 63 characters, domain at most 253, and the TLD must end in a letter. Reserved `ab--` labels are rejected. Special-use domains (`arpa`, `invalid`, `local`, `localhost`, `onion`, `test`, and their subdomains) are rejected.
- **Unicode domains** are converted to punycode with the platform `URL` parser instead of porting IDNA.
- **Whole address:** at most 254 UTF-8 octets, at most 2048 characters (pydantic's limit). Surrounding whitespace is ignored, because pydantic strips it.


Self-hosted account creation now rejects special-use domains such as `user@corp.local` in the UI, because `EmailStr` rejects them on the server; the error shows before submit instead of as an API failure. Profile and invitation keep accepting them, as their endpoints do.

**Backend**

- [ ] A specific backend branch from Landscape server must be utilized locally — Branch: `______`
- [x] No specific backend branch required
- [ ] Not Applicable

**Where to Find the UI Changes (if applicable)**

> - **Login** — `http://localhost:5173/login`, email/password login (identity/PAM login disabled).
> - **Invite administrator** — **Settings** → **Administrators** → **Invite administrator**.
> - **Edit user** — **Account** → **General** → edit user details.
> - **Create account (self-hosted)** — `http://localhost:5173/create-account`.

**Testing Instructions** _(optional)_

1. In each form above, enter `user+tag@example.com`. No validation error should appear, and submitting should succeed.
2. Enter `us..er@example.com` and `John Doe <john@example.com>`. Each should show "Please provide a valid email address". `user@example.local` fails only on the create-account form; invite and profile accept it and reject `用户@example.com` instead.
3. Leave the email empty. It should show "This field is required" (not the email error).
4. Run the tests:
   ```bash
   pnpm exec vitest run src/utils/validation src/features/auth/components/LoginForm src/features/auth/components/LoginMethodsLayout src/features/administrators/components/InviteAdministratorForm src/features/general-settings/components/EditUserForm src/features/account-creation/components/AccountCreationSelfHostedForm
   ```

**Test coverage**

- `email.test.ts` checks 114 addresses (44 the server accepts, 67 it rejects, 3 pretty-name forms) plus the `emailSchema` behaviour. Every expected result was produced by running the address through pydantic 2.4.2 `EmailStr`.
- `email.test.ts` also checks 50 addresses against the legacy `is_email_address` rules.
- Each of the four forms has a new test showing a plus-addressed email is accepted. Invite and profile also cover `corp.local`, a non-ASCII local part and the Unicode-dot normalization.
- Results: all Vitest tests pass; `tsc`, eslint and prettier are clean.

## Versioning Reminder

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Landscape UI uses **CalVer** (`YY.MM.Point.Build`). Version derivation by branch:
>
> - `main` / `point/*` → `YY.MM.0.<run>-beta`
> - `dev` → `YY.MM.0.<run>-dev`
> - `release/YY.MM` → `YY.MM.1.<run>` (cycle pinned by branch name)
